title: Basis expanded generator
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and nonzero $\ell$, and elements $r,s$ of the binary extension field of degree $\ell$, the basis expanded small bias generator is the binary cube of length $n\ell$ obtained by applying the field pairing generator to the basis expanded small bias field family at $r$, with second parameter $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ and $s$ belong to the binary extension field of degree $\ell$
caveat: The definitions of `fieldPairingGenerator` and the basis expanded field family are not supplied.
